About.title: About our club
About.intro: US Basketball NL was founded in 1985 and has grown into a lively amateur basketball club in Utrecht. What started with a single team is today a club with teams for children, youth, adults and seniors.

history.title: History
history.p1: The club was founded in 1985 by a group of basketball enthusiasts who wanted to make the sport accessible to everyone in Utrecht. The first season counted just one team and a handful of loyal players.
history.p2: Over the years the club grew steadily. New teams were added, the first youth department was created in the early nineties, and today the club fields teams from under-10 to seniors, both for men and women.

Teams.title: Our teams
Teams.intro: From the youngest rookies to our senior teams: at US Basketball NL there is a team for everyone. Each team trains weekly with qualified coaches.

u10.description: Learning the basics of basketball through fun games and exercises. The emphasis is on having fun and developing motor skills.

u12.description: The first real basketball skills: dribbling, passing and the first matches in the competition.

u16.name: Under-16
u16.description: Youth players who train several times a week and play competition matches in the region.

seniors.name: Seniors
seniors.description: Recreational senior teams that play in the regional competition. For players who are serious about the game, but still do it for fun.

Membership.title: Membership
Membership.intro: Become a member of US Basketball NL. Below you will find the fees and the rules for registration and deregistration.

fees.title: Membership fees
fees.note: Fees are paid per season (September - June). Prices are indicative and can be adjusted by the board.

family.label: Family discount
family.per: for the second and next family member

register.title: Registration
register.p1: Registration runs through the online sign-up form on this website. After submitting the form your membership starts immediately; you can pay the season fee within 14 days.
register.p2: You can come and train twice for free to decide if the club is a good fit before you commit.

deregister.title: Deregistration
deregister.p1: Deregistration is possible at the end of the season with a notice period of one month, via an email to the board.
deregister.p2: Players who deregister mid-season remain liable for the season fee for the current season.
deregister.p3: After deregistration your account stays accessible for one year so you can simply rejoin.

q1.q: Can I come and train once to try it out?
q1.a: Yes. You can join a training twice for free before you decide to become a member. Sign up via the form and let us know you'd like to try out.

q2.a: No. We have teams and trainings for all levels, from beginners to experienced players. Tell us your level and we'll find a team that fits.

q3.q: What does the membership fee include?
q3.a: The season fee covers your trainings, competition matches, refereeing and the use of the clubhouse. Basketball outfit and shoes are not included.

q4.a: You can deregister at the end of the season with a notice period of one month by sending an email to the board.

cta.title: Become a member
cta.description: Signing up only takes a few minutes.

who.title: Who are we?
who.p: US Basketball NL is the data controller for the personal data processed on this website and in our administration. You can reach us via info@usbasketballnl.example.

data.title: What data do we collect?
data.p: When you register as a member we collect your first and last name, email address, phone number and the team you play in. When you use the website we may process analytics data (anonymised).

purpose.title: What do we use your data for?
purpose.p: We process your data to manage your membership, communicate about trainings and matches, process the season fee and comply with legal obligations. We never sell your data to third parties.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p: You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, and the right to object to certain processing. You can exercise these rights by contacting the board. If you have a complaint you can contact the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

retention.title: How long do we keep your data?
retention.p: We keep membership data for as long as you are a member and up to one year after deregistration. Financial records are kept as required by law.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.p: This website uses cookies. Analytical cookies (such as GA4) are only placed after you give consent via the cookie banner. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
